units.source_text: 既不像有心思回嘴，也不见有辩解的动静。

en.t: She seemed neither inclined to talk back nor about to offer any excuse.

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，等到她确认男人已经不说了，

en.t: After a while, once she was sure the man had stopped speaking,

units.source_text: 她又慢慢挪动起身子来，简直像什么事也没有发生过似的，

en.t: she slowly began moving again, just as if nothing at all had happened,
and went back to the work she had in hand.

units.source_text: 她抽掉壁橱天棚的盖板，

en.t: She pulled away the ceiling panel of the closet,

units.source_text: 用手肘撑着钻进上半身，笨拙地手忙脚乱地爬了上去。

en.t: propped herself on her elbows, squeezed her upper body through, and clambered up awkwardly in a fluster.

units.source_text: 这边、那边，到处都吊下来一条条细线，落沙开始了。

en.t: Here and there, everywhere, thin strands hung down one after another, and the sand began to fall.

units.source_text: 他感到这天花板里面像是有什么稀奇古怪的虫……

en.t: He felt as if some strange, bizarre insect were inside the ceiling...

units.source_text: 哦，够了，全是怪事，已经太多喽！

en.t: Oh, enough. Everything was strange; it was already too much!
